name: tiling
description: A scrolling tiling window manager, redone: panes as floating glass cards over Hokusai's Great Wave, a cyan focus border, new terminals and browsers in columns of their own that scroll sideways, focus follows the mouse, links open in a new column, and a thin rail sidebar with numbered workspaces and a status bar of panes, tabs, agents at work and the time.

files.themes/last-demo-tiling.json:
// Tiling: a riced desktop. Hokusai's Great Wave behind clear glass, every pane a glass card with
// a gap around it, a cyan accent and focus border, square-ish corners, a compact strip.
{
  "name": "Tiling",
  "description": "Glass pane cards over the Great Wave; a cyan accent and focus border.",

  "appearance.theme": "TokyoNight",
  "colors": {
    "background": "#0b1622",
    "foreground": "#d8e6f0",
    "cursor": "#5ce1e6",
    "selection": "#1c3346",
    "accent": "#5ce1e6",
    "1": "#ff6b7f",
    "2": "#7ee6a1",
    "3": "#f5c76b",
    "4": "#6fb6ff",
    "5": "#b79cff",
    "6": "#5ce1e6"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  "appearance.background": "hokusai-great-wave",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.8,
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "glass",
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0.3,

  "appearance.chromeStyle": "blocks",
  "appearance.borders": "none",

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#08111b",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.74,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "card",

  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#0b1622",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.84,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#0b1622",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.88,

  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#5ce1e6",

  "appearance.density": "compact"
}
